payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-10-24: re-read the nine undated sources from their publishers on 24 Oct. Two now state a visible last-updated date, banked verbatim as update statements under the 26 Sep rule (4AT-OFFICIAL 25 Sep 2026, AUS-HEALTH-ASSIST-2025 3 Jun 2025); both stay held. Seven still show no visible date: AMHOCN-NOCC, COLUMBIA-CSSRS, COPE-EPDS-2026, DIVA-FOUNDATION, NACCHO-ACCHO-2026, NACCHO-AHW-2026, NACCHO-SEWB-2026 (NACCHO, Columbia and AMHOCN carry dates only in page metadata, which the rule excludes). The dispositions change sits under a hazard-controls drift exception pending owner review and reseal.
